description: Systemy kolejkowe is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Miasto stołeczne Warszawa. Dane z systemów kolejkowych jednostek Urzędu m.st. Warszawy i Dzielnic Dostęp do zbioru wymaga rejestracji na stronie Warunki korzystania z danych są dostępne na stronie. Coverage: Miasto stołeczne Warszawa. The publisher named on the listing is Miasto stołeczne Warszawa. Its keywords include system kolejkowy, on-line, Warszawa. The listing shows 2026-06-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
